BiblicalUsage: Darius set his heart on Daniel to deliver him, and laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him. The Aramaic word is to strive, to labour hard at a thing, and the king's striving was honest but useless: the law of the Medes and Persians could not be changed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Darius shows the limit of a king's good intentions, for he laboured all day to save one man and could not, and I hold that only God delivers where the law cannot.
